name: Community Sentinel — post a cited anomaly to Discord
description: Demo 2. Fires the relay when ANY finding (info+) lands on the live feed. The relay formats a Discord embed with the method, severity, row, |z|, and the 0-fabricated chip; the channel sees it live on camera. This is the proven 'I gave my Discord a local AI' format with automation baked in.

metadata.note: Set AURORA_DEMO_DISCORD_WEBHOOK to your channel's incoming-webhook URL before starting the relay. The relay's discord_adapter turns the envelope into a Block-Kit-style embed.
